about_the_game:
Let your heroes take a break from saving the world and just enjoy a trip with the KR Transportation Station - Cruise Ship Tileset!

Start your heroes’ vacation by dropping all their luggage in their cabin, carefully tucking it between the blue couch and pillow-filled bed, before heading to the ship’s bow to watch the bridge send the ship sailing into inviting blue water.

Let your players choose if they want to relax on a lounge chair under an umbrella on one of the ship’s decks or explore the halls with patterned rugs and sea-themed paintings before enjoying a concert on the ship’s stage.

This pack also includes 12 character sprites to add more function to your maps!

If your modern game’s heroes need a chance to breathe between adventures or you want to have a murder mystery where your players know the murderer is among them, pick up the KR Transportation Station - Cruise Ship Tileset!


The Transportation Station ~ Cruise Ship tileset includes:

Ground tiles

Water tiles, both ocean and pool (pool has 2 styles)
Plain floors in concrete gray, white and black
Wood floors (with and without border)
3 types of tile floors, light gray, charcoal gray and tan
5 types of rugs – plain gold and blue, plus blue and red rugs with star pattern and wacky pattern rug
4 types of tables
2 brick patterns – light and dark gray

Wall tiles:

Walls to match floors, plus grate pattern, small tile in gray and tan, windows and a tan wall.

Also includes:

Radio tower (complete copy and paste object)
Small antennas and radar
Funnel
Complete lower ship assembly, which can be made longer or shorter according to your preference (unfortunately not wider, due to the shape)
Angled windows of several styles
Cabin balcony partitions (2 sizes)
Various railing pieces
Staircases (diagonal and vertical)
Lifeboat (with animations for escape sequences)
Helicopter pad and helicopter
Pool accessories – left and right facing tube slides (they align to tiles so you can easily make animations where your character appears to slide down), diving boards, ladders, etc
Beach towels, life jackets, pool inflatables and other accessories
Large umbrellas
Shuffleboard set (horizontal and vertical)
Cabin furniture – 2 styles of chairs, couch, wall panels and mirrors, beds in 2 sizes (north-south and east-west facing), lamps and lighting, end tables, cabinets (with accessory options for below countertops), wall decor, suitcases, vacation wear on hangers, refreshments like coffee and tea, toiletries, bathroom fixtures (with shower and large tub) and more!
Dining hall with fancy pillar, chandelier, tables with place settings, flowers and fancy white chairs
Stage tiles for live shows, with instruments, lighting, speakers and more
Shopping, with fashion, souvenirs, convenience store and snacks
Bridge tiles, with seating and several consoles you can connect to make different arrangements


Events and Animations

Fountains
Doors of various types – includes sideways door (check sample maps for proper alignment, they need a hallway two tiles long to have proper room) and angled doorways
Elevator
Helicopter with various states
Lifeboat (moving and still)
Radar
Water splash animation (for use around hull)


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
